Article Title: ‘Shortcuts will cut you short’: PM Modi’s message for youngsters at former President Kovind’s autobiography launch
Article Text:
Former President Ram Nath Kovind with PM Narendra Modi at book launch

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Wednesday urged youngsters to avoid taking shortcuts in life, warning that “a shortcut will cut you short.”He made the remarks while releasing the autobiography of former President Ram Nath Kovind in the national capital."I would particularly like to urge the younger generation—we live in the age of 'Reels' and social media influencers. Even in this era of shortcuts, let us remember something often written at railway stations: A shortcut will cut you short," PM Modi said.He also encouraged youngsters to read the autobiographies of personalities they admire, saying such accounts offer a unique perspective on the historic events of their time.“The period covered in a biography brings one very close to history itself. That is why I sincerely hope that the hard work put in by Kovind ji proves beneficial to future generations and especially to the youth,” PM Modi added.PM Modi further praised Kovind’s "guidance" and recalled the former president's “special affection and warmth” for him.“Today, we have the opportunity to witness the launch of Ramnath Kovind ji's autobiography.I have known Kovind ji for a very long time and have had the opportunity to know him closely. His guidance during his tenure as President, along with his special affection and warmth towards me, has been a truly valuable asset for me,” he said.Expressing confidence in the book’s significance, the prime minister described Kovind’s autobiography as a potential “cherished legacy” for Indian democracy and society.“... Based on my understanding of his life and my knowledge of his capabilities, I can say with full confidence that Ramnath Kovind ji's autobiography will become a cherished legacy for Indian democracy and society. There is so much I could speak about at length--regarding Kovind ji's life journey and his contributions to society and the nation. However, a book launch event should only serve as a 'curtain-raiser'; it is best if you all derive the full benefit of the book by reading it yourselves,” he added.Meanwhile, Kovind described the launch as an emotional moment and expressed gratitude to those who attended the event.“It is an emotional moment for me to address you all from this platform today. I have addressed you on several occasions, but today's occasion is different. I am grateful to all of you for joining this programme to mark the launch of my autobiography. I was wondering what I should say today. I have already written everything in my autobiography, and readers will read it,” the former president remarked.
Article Summary: PM Narendra Modi urges youngsters to avoid taking shortcuts in life. He made the remarks while releasing the autobiography of former President Ram Nath Kovind. PM Modi further praised Kovind’s "guidance" and recalled the former president's “special affection and warmth” for him.

Article Title: Old allies, new equation? Why SAD and BJP may join hands for 2027 Punjab assembly elections
Article Text:
BJP-SAD alliance buzz grows after PM Modi-Badal meeting

SAD's electoral decline

BJP-SAD alliance lasted nearly two decades before the parties split over the farm laws in 2020

Badal's changed tune on delimitation

'Why so desperate for BJP alliance?'

Why SAD alliance can help BJP

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

BJP's bid to dominate?

NEW DELHI: Will the BJP and the Shiromani Akali Dal revive their decades-old ties in Punjab for the 2027 assembly elections? Haryana chief minister Nayab Singh Saini, who has been playing a key role in BJP’s Punjab plans, has ruled out any such possibility. His denial comes amid a strong alliance buzz triggered by a meeting between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD) chief Sukhbir Singh Badal last week - the first such meeting after the two parties snapped ties 6 years ago over the 3 farm bills.BJP’s Saini has played down alliance rumours. When asked to comment on the meeting, Saini replied in Punjabi, "Nahi, aise koyi gall nahi hai (No, there is no such thing)". The Haryana chief minister said the Prime Minister is the voice of 140 crore people. "If anyone wants to meet him, his doors are open; anyone can meet. Political parties keep meeting him for various issues."Saini further added, "Bharatiya Janata Party ka gathbandhan Punjab di janta de naal hai. (BJP's alliance is with the people of Punjab). And I say this with great confidence because I meet people there. In Punjab, the BJP is forming its government."So, can Saini’s denial be taken at face value? Or is it just political rhetoric to keep pressure on a regional party which appears desperate for an alliance with the BJP?Sukhbir Singh Badal, who has served two terms as deputy chief minister of Punjab and whose father Parkash Singh Badal was a 5-time chief minister, has been struggling to make a political comeback in the state. In the last two assembly elections, his party, SAD, has been pushed to the margins.The decline began in the 2017 assembly elections, when the SAD won only 15 of the 94 seats it contested, with a vote share of 25.24%. This was a sharp decline compared to its 2012 performance when the SAD had won 56 seats with a vote share of 34.73%. If 2017 was a worry, 2022, after it snapped ties with the BJP and contested alone, was a clear warning: the SAD could win only 3 seats, and its vote share dipped to 18.38%.This decline was not limited to just assembly elections. In the Lok Sabha elections too, SAD suffered a decline. In 2019, the SAD polled 27.76% of votes and won 2 seats. Five years later, while the seat reduced to 1, the vote share dipped to 13.48%. In 2014, the SAD tally in Lok Sabha was 4 seats and a 26.37% vote share.Clearly, for Sukhbir Singh Badal, both the crisis and the test are real. And that perhaps explains his visible desperation for an alliance with the BJP. And while the saffron party may reject alliance rumours, the SAD has sent clear signals of a strategic shift — extending a friendly hand to the BJP.In April this year, Badal had criticised the Centre’s move on delimitation of Lok Sabha seats in the garb of the Women’s Reservation Bill. "Punjab is predominantly a minority character state. We will be the biggest victim of this population-based delimitation. Compared with a nominal increase in seats for Punjab, Haryana will witness a nearly hundred per cent increase and double the number of its seats in the Lok Sabha," Badal had then said in a statement.Four months later, the SAD chief has literally taken a U-turn on the issue. After his meeting with PM Modi, Badal changed his stand and demanded the immediate implementation of the Women’s Reservation Bill. He also supported the Union government’s proposal to increase Parliament seats in states by 50 per cent.In a new statement after his meeting with PM Modi, Badal said the party stood for a fair and equitable delimitation exercise that ensured equal increase in representation to all states. “This will ensure justice is done to all states,” he said.Badal’s changed stand prompted a dig from Punjab Congress president Amarinder Singh Raja Warring, who asked the Shiromani Akali Dal chief as to why he was so desperate for an electoral alliance with the BJP that he had to make a U-turn on a sensitive matter like delimitation of the assembly and parliamentary constituencies.“What changed within these months that you started seeing merit in the same Bill, you otherwise found against Punjab’s interests?” he asked. “Sukhbir has turned more loyal than the king within no time,” Warring said.He said when the Akalis had failed to reach an alliance with the BJP ahead of the parliamentary elections, Badal had claimed that he did not want to compromise on the interests of Punjab. “Now that you are desperate for your own survival, you have simply forgotten the interests of Punjab for which you claimed to have taken a stand in 2024,” said Warring.Chief minister Bhagwant Mann also took potshots at Badal and said, "BJP can make them do whatever they want. SAD just wants to get back into the cabinet in Delhi or get into an alliance with the BJP in Punjab."These reactions would suggest that both the ruling AAP and the Congress are perhaps aware how a potential BJP-Akali alliance could change the dynamics on ground. While they may play down the possible impact of this alliance, they would be keeping a close eye on the developments. AAP would hope that the 2027 Punjab contest stays four-cornered so that the ruling party can benefit from the division of opposition votes. The Congress, on the other hand, realises that SAD could help the BJP in rural areas and add to the party's challenges in the state.Little wonder, Badal would not mind their political barbs as long as he can secure the future of his party with the BJP. And that brings us to Saini’s remark playing down the meeting between PM Modi and Sukhbir Badal.For the BJP, the Akali association is electorally important, at least for now. The BJP has just two seats in the current assembly with a vote share of 6.6%. The party could not win a single seat in the 2024 Lok Sabha elections despite polling 18.65% of votes. This was almost double of the 9.74% that the BJP managed in 2019 Lok Sabha elections. It was also a huge jump from the 2022 assembly elections when the BJP got just 6.6% of votes. But the fact that BJP could win 2 Lok Sabha seats in 2019 despite a low vote share points to the importance of SAD alliance in converting votes to seats in the state.Despite the sharp decline in its electoral fortunes, the Shiromani Akali Dal still has good support base in rural Punjab and also has a strong Sikh-centric regional identity - both of which can help the BJP in case of an alliance. Combined with BJP's urban support base, this can turn into a winning combination for the two parties. The SAD has been going all out to increase its base and presence in the state.The controversy around movie Satluj, which narrates the life story of activist Jaswant Singh Khalra - who uncovered alleged extrajudicial cremations in Punjab between mid-1980s and early-1990s, gave SAD the much-needed boost to woo its core voters. When the movie was taken down from the OTT platform, SAD arranged its screening across Punjab. In a post on X in Punjabi, Badal had then said, "In every village and corner of Punjab, the SAD will screen the film 'Satluj' based on inhuman atrocities inflicted on thousands of innocent Sikh youth and Sikh personalities like Shaheed Bhai Jaswant Singh Ji Khalra during the Congress regime, so that our children and future generations can be thoroughly acquainted with the oppression inflicted. "Badal had justified the move and said:"This is aimed at ensuring that today's youth and our coming generations know about the unspeakable tragedy and repression unleashed by the then Congress governments against Bhai Jaswant Singh Khalra and thousands of other innocent Sikh youth who were eliminated through fake encounters." The aggressive SAD campaign was clearly a move to consolidate its ‘Panthic’ vote bank - a political mobilisation surrounding the Sikh community’s collective identity.The SAD perhaps can complement the BJP if the two parties eventually agree for an alliance.Hence, the BJP’s posturing vis-a-vis the SAD alliance at present perhaps has more to do with asserting who will dictate terms if and when the two parties join hands. And this is important as till 2020, when the partnership snapped, the SAD was the senior partner in Punjab’s NDA alliance and the BJP played second fiddle. That political dynamic has changed now. By repeatedly asserting that it will contest the Punjab elections on its own, the BJP has clearly spread the message that it will lead the fight and not play the junior partner to anyone. Hence, the saffron party would not want to miss any opportunity to reinforce this message to the SAD leadership and its cadres.True, the BJP is working on a roadmap to increase its political base and strength and become an independent political force in Punjab. This is manifested in the several steps that the party has taken in Punjab. From Prime Minister’s Punjab rallies to party chief Nitin Nabin’s push and targeted acquisition from political rivals, the BJP has made it clear that it means business in Punjab. But the party perhaps will need more time to do a Bengal in Punjab, if at all it ever happens. For now, SAD perhaps could be its best bet in Punjab.
Article Summary: BJP-SAD alliance lasted nearly two decades before the parties split over the farm laws in 2020. Haryana chief minister Nayab Singh Saini, who has been playing a key role in BJP’s Punjab plans, has ruled out any such possibility.

Article Title: The road not taken, every day: Why do potholes keep coming back
Article Text:
Pothole-related deaths in India rose by over 53% in five years, from 1,555 in 2020 to 2,385 in 2024.

From a tiny crack to a full-blown pothole, here's how road damage turns into a recurring cycle of patch and repair.

Every pothole starts small

A police officer fills a pothole with stones on a road, at Edappally, in Kochi. (Image credit: PTI)

Why does the pothole come back after it is fixed

Potholes on Bengaluru roads (Image credit: PTI)

What data shows

Can we stop pothole before it becomes a pothole?

How speed, rain, poor visibility and heavy traffic can turn a road defect into a serious hazard.

Do you also have a “work in progress” sign permanently living outside your house?One day, someone digs up the road to lay a water pipe. A few days later, another team arrives to fix a cable. Then comes the patchwork. And just when you think the road is finally back to normal, congratulations, it is dug up again.The road outside your house may technically be the same road, but it has seen so many rounds of digging, filling, breaking and repairing that it almost has a career history.And then, inevitably, the potholes arrive.We often blame potholes on bad roads, heavy rain or poor construction. But a pothole is rarely born overnight. In fact, that annoying crater that makes your car suspension groan or sends a two-wheeler rider swerving usually has a long backstory.A crack appears. Water gets in. The road weakens. Traffic keeps pounding it. The surface finally gives way.And if the underlying problem isn't fixed, filling the hole may only be a temporary solution.The road gets dug up. Again. And again.Before we get to the pothole itself, there is another character in this story: road digging.Roads don't just carry vehicles. They carry water pipelines, sewage lines, electricity cables, telecom networks and other utilities underneath them. Whenever something needs to be repaired, replaced or newly installed, the road may have to be opened.The problem begins when the road is not restored to the same standard after the work is completed.A poorly compacted patch can become weaker than the surrounding pavement. Water can seep into the edges. Traffic repeatedly hits the repaired section. Eventually, cracks appear.And suddenly, the “temporary” patch becomes the next pothole.This is one reason why road maintenance cannot simply mean filling visible holes. What happens underneath the road matters just as much as what you see on top.The first warning sign is usually something you wouldn't give a second glance: a tiny crack.Road surfaces are constantly under pressure. India's roads have to handle enormous traffic volumes, heavy vehicles and, in many parts of the country, intense heat followed by heavy monsoon rain.Temperature changes cause pavement materials to expand and contract. Repeated traffic loads create fatigue. Overloaded vehicles put additional stress on the surface.Then the monsoon arrives.That tiny crack suddenly becomes a doorway.Water is the real troublemakerRain itself isn't necessarily the villain. Water getting beneath the road is.Once water enters through a crack, it can reach the layers beneath the asphalt. If drainage is poor, clogged or badly designed, the water may remain there instead of being carried away.The result is gradual weakening of the road's foundation.The surface may still look fine from above. Underneath, however, the supporting layers can lose strength and material can be washed or displaced, creating weak spots and voids.And then traffic does what traffic does best: keeps coming.Then the tyres take overImagine standing on a floor that has suddenly become slightly hollow underneath. Now imagine thousands of vehicles repeatedly pressing down on that same spot.That is essentially what happens to a road whose underlying layers have weakened.With every passing vehicle, the damaged surface experiences another load. Bits of asphalt loosen, the depression grows and eventually the surface collapses.That is your pothole.And once it forms, it can become a vicious cycle.Rainwater collects in the depression. More water finds its way into the surrounding pavement. The edges weaken. Vehicles hit the damaged section. More material breaks away.A small pothole can therefore become a much bigger one surprisingly quickly, especially during the rainy season.Now comes the question every commuter has asked at least once:“Didn't they just repair this?”Yes. But repairing the hole and repairing the road are not always the same thing.If workers simply fill the visible depression while the layers underneath remain damaged, the surface may fail again.It is a bit like filling a dent in a wall without fixing the leak behind it.The road may look perfect for a while. Then water gets in again, traffic starts pounding the weak section and — hello, pothole.This is why preventive maintenance matters. A small crack can often be dealt with before it becomes structural damage. Once the road base itself has deteriorated, the repair becomes more complicated, expensive and disruptive.And not all potholes are equally dangerousA pothole's danger isn't determined by its size alone.A small hole on a busy, high-speed road can be far more dangerous than a giant one on an empty lane.For two-wheelers, an unexpected depression can destabilise the vehicle. On a crowded road, a driver trying to avoid a pothole may suddenly brake or swerve. At night, poor lighting can make the defect difficult to spot. During rain, water can completely hide its depth.So the real danger is a combination of the pothole, speed, traffic, visibility and road conditions.Potholes claimed 9,438 lives across India between 2020 and 2024, with annual fatalities rising from 1,555 in 2020 to 2,385 in 2024 — a jump of more than 53% in five years. Uttar Pradesh accounted for more than half of the national toll, reporting 5,127 deaths. Madhya Pradesh followed with 969 fatalities, while Tamil Nadu recorded 612, Odisha 425, Punjab 414 and Assam 395. Among Union Territories, Delhi reported the highest toll at 50.But the numbers also raise questions about how pothole-related crashes are recorded. States such as Andhra Pradesh and Bihar reported zero crashes, injuries or deaths under this category, even as states such as Manipur, Nagaland and Tripura reported fatalities. Experts say gaps in objective crash-cause reporting could mean the data does not fully capture the scale of the problem.The toll, however, remains below the 2017 peak of 3,597 pothole-related deaths. The Supreme Court took suo motu cognisance of the issue in 2018, observing that authorities responsible for maintaining roads were failing in their duties.Fortunately, the answer isn't simply “keep filling holes”.A 2021 IIT Madras study found that nearly 78% of urban potholes reported by citizens remained unfixed for more than two weeks, with delays particularly serious in high-traffic areas.Technology can help road agencies identify damage earlier through road-condition monitoring, GIS mapping and scanning systems. Quick repair methods can deal with certain defects before they expand.Citizen reporting can also help — provided complaints actually lead to inspection and action.Because the person who encounters a dangerous pothole may not be a road engineer inspecting the highway once a month. It may be a delivery rider passing through it ten times a day.But technology alone won't solve the problem.Road agencies need better coordination too. If one department digs up a road to lay a cable and another has to repair it later, someone needs to ensure the road is restored properly. Otherwise, the same stretch can enter an endless loop of dig → patch → crack → pothole → repair → dig again.The pothole is only the final chapterSo, the next time you see a pothole outside your home, remember: that hole probably didn't just “appear”.It may have started as a tiny crack.Then came rainwater. Maybe a badly repaired utility cut. Maybe years of heavy traffic. Maybe poor drainage. Maybe all of them.By the time you notice the crater, the real damage may already be underneath.Which is why the real solution isn't simply asking, “Who will fill this pothole?”It is asking a much more important question:“Why did this road fail in the first place — and why wasn't it fixed before it got this bad?”Because if the answer remains unclear, that freshly filled pothole may just be waiting for its next monsoon comeback.
Article Summary: Pothole-related deaths in India rose by over 53% in five years, from 1,555 in 2020 to 2,385 in 2024. From a tiny crack to a full-blown pothole, here's how road damage turns into a recurring cycle of patch and repair.

Article Title: Search ops involving Indian Navy for 3 missing fishermen continue in Kerala: Official
Article Text:
INS Kalpeni sailed from Kochi on Saturday night to join the search operation and anchored one nautical mile off Neendakara on Sunday morning (Representative image)

NEW DELHI: A search operation involving the Indian Navy for three fishermen who went missing following separate boat mishaps off Kollam and Thiruvananthapuram coasts will continue on Monday, a defence spokesperson has said.The search operation for Gautam Krishna, John and Shijin -- who went missing in separate fishing boat mishaps at Neendakara (in Kollam), Vizhinjam and Muthalappozhi (in Thiruvananthapuram), respectively, on July 31 -- entered its 10th day on Sunday.On Sunday, Indian Navy divers joined the Coast Police, Coast Guard and Marine Enforcement Wing of the fisheries department to search for the three missing fishermen.INS Kalpeni sailed from Kochi on Saturday night to join the search operation and anchored one nautical mile off Neendakara on Sunday morning, the spokesperson said.The divers are using portable SONAR, which enhances their capability for underwater surveillance and diving operations, the spokesperson said. The Navy initially focused its search on Gautam Krishna, who went missing after his fishing boat capsized off the Neendakara coast. Later in the evening, INS Kalpeni moved to Muthalappozhi harbour to continue the search.
Article Summary: The search operation for Gautam Krishna, John and Shijin entered its 10th day on Sunday. Indian Navy divers joined the Coast Police, Coast Guard and Marine Enforcement Wing of the fisheries department to search for the three missing fishermen. The divers are using portable SONAR, which enhances their capability for underwater surveillance and diving operations.

Article Title: IPL cricketer Abishek Porel arrested in rape case; Bengal Police take Delhi Capitals player into custody
Article Text:
Abishek Porel (ANI Photo)

Arrest follows Calcutta High Court order

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Porel's cricket career now overshadowed

Bengal and Delhi Capitals wicketkeeper-batter Abishek Porel was arrested by Bengal Police on Tuesday in connection with a rape case filed by a medical student, according to an official quoted by PTI.Porel was taken into custody in Hooghly and formally arrested after being questioned, with the 23-year-old subsequently sent for a medical examination and produced before the Chinsurah Court.The case stems from a complaint filed at Mogra Police Station by a woman who has alleged that Porel established a physical relationship with her on the promise of marriage. The complaint also contains allegations of criminal intimidation and the recording of intimate moments.The allegations have not been established in court and the matter remains under investigation.The development comes weeks after the Calcutta High Court directed Bengal Police to arrest Porel in connection with the case.In an order dated July 14, Justice Saugata Bhattacharyya directed police to continue efforts to apprehend Porel and another accused. The court also ordered the seizure of electronic devices in order to prevent the dissemination of alleged private material linked to the complainant.Police had told the court that a pen drive had already been seized and sent for forensic examination. The complainant had approached the High Court alleging police inaction and also claimed that Porel had threatened to make private photographs public.According to the complaint, the woman first came into contact with Porel in 2023 and alleged that their relationship subsequently led to discussions about marriage involving their families.She has further alleged that she was assaulted and confined during an incident in Delhi on April 2, 2026, and that she was denied food and subsequently required medical attention. These are allegations contained in the complaint and have not been proven.Porel has been a prominent figure in Bengal cricket and has represented Delhi Capitals in the Indian Premier League. A left-handed wicketkeeper-batter, he made his first-class debut for Bengal during the 2021-22 season and subsequently earned India A call-ups.He joined the Delhi Capitals setup in 2023 and has been part of the franchise's IPL squad in recent seasons.The legal case now represents a major development in the young cricketer's career, with the investigation and court proceedings set to determine the next steps.The complainant's allegations include rape, criminal intimidation and other offences. Porel has previously denied the allegations and indicated that he would respond in detail after the police inquiry.With his arrest now confirmed, the case moves into the next stage of the legal process. Porel remains an accused, and any determination of guilt will be made through the judicial process.
Article Summary: Abishek Porel arrested by Bengal Police in connection with rape case. 23-year- old was taken into custody in Hooghly and formally arrested after being questioned. Calcutta High Court had ordered police to arrest the wicketkeeper- batter. Case stems from a complaint filed by a medical student. Complaint alleges PoreL established a physical relationship with her on the promise of marriage.

Article Title: 'Hopeful' Bangladesh races to save India tour, says foreign ministers involved in talks
Article Text:
Mohammad Saifuddin of Bangladesh bats during the Asia Cup match between India and Bangladesh at Dubai International Stadium on September 24, 2025 in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. (Photo/Getty Images)

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Bangladesh is trying to save India's six-match cricket tour next month, with the foreign ministers of both countries involved in efforts to resolve the issue, news agency AFP reported.The tour consists of three ODIs and three T20Is. It was originally scheduled for August last year but was postponed after relations between Dhaka and New Delhi deteriorated.Bangladesh sports minister Aminul Haque said on Monday that discussions were continuing at the ministerial level."It is being worked on at the ministerial level," Haque said late Monday, as quoted by AFP, adding that talks were ongoing between the foreign ministers of both countries.Relations between Bangladesh and India have been strained since a mass uprising in Bangladesh in 2024 led to the removal of then-prime minister Sheikh Hasina. She fled to India, where she remains in hiding.In February, Bangladesh did not send a team to India for the T20 World Cup, citing security concerns. The International Cricket Council rejected Bangladesh's request to move its matches to Sri Lanka, and Scotland replaced them in the tournament.Haque said Bangladesh was keen to resolve the issue surrounding the postponed series."We want to quickly resolve the deadlock that was created around the Cricket World Cup," Haque said."God willing, we are hopeful that it will be resolved very soon."India last toured Bangladesh for a cricket series in 2022, when they won the two-Test series 2-0. Bangladesh won the three-match ODI series 2-1.Bangladesh last toured India in September-October 2024 for two Tests and two T20Is. India won both series, completing a sweep across the two formats.
Article Summary: Bangladesh trying to save India's six-match cricket tour next month. Foreign ministers of both countries involved in efforts to resolve the issue. The tour consists of three ODIs and three T20Is. It was originally scheduled for August last year but was postponed.

Article Title: Inspiring story of the day: “She is the person who makes me feel complete.” - How Cristiano Ronaldo and his wife Georgina Rodríguez built a family legacy beyond football
Article Text:
Inspiring story of the day: “She is the person who makes me feel complete.” - How Cristiano Ronaldo and his wife Georgina Rodríguez built a family legacy beyond football

How did Cristiano Ronaldo and Georgina Rodríguez meet

How did Cristiano Ronaldo and Georgina Rodríguez build their family

How did Cristiano Ronaldo and Georgina Rodríguez face tragedy

Why is Cristiano Ronaldo’s marriage to Georgina Rodríguez huge

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Cristiano Ronaldo and Georgina Rodríguez are married, turning a relationship that began in Madrid a decade ago into a chapter for their family. The couple tied the knot in a civil ceremony in Cascais, Portugal, on August 11, 2026, according to People. Their story has never been only about Ronaldo’s football career. It has also included five children, a devastating loss, moves across countries and years of questions about marriage. Now husband and wife, Ronaldo and Rodríguez have reached a milestone they once spoke about as something that would happen when the right moment came.Cristiano Ronaldo and Georgina Rodríguez first crossed paths in Madrid in 2016, when Rodríguez was working at a Gucci store. Ronaldo was playing for Real Madrid at the time, and what started as a brief meeting soon became a relationship that changed both their lives.Rodríguez has spoken about that first meeting and how she noticed Ronaldo. The pair later made their relationship public, appearing together at the Best FIFA Football Awards in January 2017. Ronaldo’s eldest son, Cristiano Jr., was also with them at the event.Their early relationship was not built around a wedding or a big public announcement.Instead, they gradually became part of each other’s daily lives. Rodríguez entered a family that already included Cristiano Jr., while Ronaldo became a major part of her life as she moved from working in a shop to becoming one of the most recognisable people in football’s inner circle.Ronaldo has also been open about how important Rodríguez became to him. In a 2019 interview with Piers Morgan, he spoke about the role she played in his life.“Geo is part of me. She’s helped me so much. I’m in love with her and she’s the passion for me. She’s great. She’s my friend. We have conversations. I open the heart for her and she opens the heart for me.”That relationship grew while Ronaldo’s career kept demanding more from him. Real Madrid was followed by Juventus, Manchester United and then Saudi Arabia, but Rodríguez remained a constant presence beside him.Family became an even bigger part of Ronaldo and Rodríguez’s story as their relationship grew. Ronaldo was already a father to Cristiano Jr. before meeting Rodríguez. In 2017, twins Eva and Mateo were born via surrogacy, and later that year Rodríguez gave birth to their daughter, Alana Martina.The couple’s family grew again in 2022, but the year also brought their hardest loss. Rodríguez was expecting twins, Bella Esmeralda and a boy named Ángel. Bella survived, while Ángel died during childbirth.The family had to deal with that loss while also caring for their other children. Ronaldo later explained how difficult it was to answer their questions when they returned home with Bella but without her twin brother.The family has since continued to raise five living children: Cristiano Jr., Eva, Mateo, Alana Martina and Bella Esmeralda. Ángel remains part of the family’s story and is remembered by his parents and siblings.For Ronaldo, fatherhood has become a major part of his life away from football. His public image is built around goals, training and records, but his family has often been the part of his life he speaks about with the most emotion.That became especially clear after the loss of Ángel. Ronaldo credited Rodríguez with helping him find the strength to return to football while their family was still dealing with grief.“Georgina came home and the kids start to say where’s the other baby, where’s the other baby? The answers were not easy, but we decided to be honest… Geo gave me that strength to get back to playing, to get back to training every day.”The loss of Ángel changed the family, but it did not break the bond between Ronaldo and Rodríguez. Instead, they had to learn how to grieve while continuing to care for their children.Ronaldo spoke about the experience in 2022, explaining that being honest with the children was part of how the family dealt with what had happened. Rodríguez also continued to share parts of family life publicly, although the couple kept the most painful parts of their loss private.That period also showed why their relationship had become more than a celebrity romance. Ronaldo’s football career has taken him around the world, while Rodríguez has built her own career in modelling, television and fashion. Yet their family life has remained at the centre of their relationship.For years, marriage was another subject that followed them. Fans and media repeatedly asked when Ronaldo and Rodríguez would get married. The answer, however, was never simply about picking a date.Ronaldo had previously said he believed the wedding would happen when they reached the right point in their relationship.“I always told her, ‘When we get that click,’ like everything with our life and she knows what I’m talking about. It could be in one year, or it could be in six months or in one month. I’m 100 percent sure it will happen… She is the person who makes me feel complete.”That moment eventually arrived. Rodríguez announced their engagement on August 11, 2025, exactly one year before their wedding. Reuters also documented the engagement announcement at the time.The wedding is huge because it closes one of the longest-running chapters in Ronaldo and Rodríguez’s relationship. For years, they lived as partners and parents without officially becoming husband and wife. Now, that has changed.Their wedding also comes after almost 10 years together, during which they built a family while Ronaldo continued one of the most demanding careers in football. Their relationship has survived constant public attention, major career moves and a deeply painful family tragedy.The couple’s story is also different from the usual football power-couple narrative because so much of it has happened away from the pitch. Ronaldo’s records and trophies made him one of the biggest names in sport, but his relationship with Rodríguez has shown another side of his life.Their five children are now part of a family shaped by both happy memories and difficult ones. Rodríguez has been beside Ronaldo through career changes, while Ronaldo has supported her as she built her own public career.The marriage does not change what Ronaldo has achieved in football. It simply adds another major moment to a personal story that has developed alongside his career.Cristiano Ronaldo conquered the football world through sheer willpower, but he found his true purpose at home. By standing shoulder-to-shoulder with his wife, Georgina, through triumph and tragedy, he proves that the most valuable title you can ever hold is being a devoted partner and parent.
Article Summary: Cristiano Ronaldo and Georgina Rodríguez are married. The couple tied the knot in a civil ceremony in Cascais, Portugal, on August 11, 2026. Their story has never been only about Ronaldo's football career. It has included five children, a devastating loss and moves across countries.

Article Title: Did Aaron Rodgers reveal a hidden NFL scandal? Were fake COVID vaccine cards really used by multiple players?
Article Text:

What Aaron Rodgers said about fake COVID-19 vaccine cards

Why Aaron Rodgers’ vaccination controversy still follows him

Aaron Rodgers has once again dragged one of the NFL ’s most divisive COVID-19 controversies back into the spotlight. The Pittsburgh Steelers quarterback recently revisited the league’s vaccination era, claiming that some players may have relied on fake vaccine cards in 2020. A former NFL scout has now backed Rodgers’ claim with an allegation of his own, saying he personally knew players who told him they had obtained fraudulent documentation.Rodgers made the comments while discussing the COVID-19 era during an appearance on The Pat McAfee Show. The quarterback has remained one of the most outspoken NFL figures when it comes to his experience during the pandemic.His latest comments revive memories of the controversy that followed him in 2021, when Rodgers tested positive for COVID-19 after previously telling reporters that he had been “immunized.” NFL reporting later confirmed that Rodgers was not vaccinated and that the league treated him as an unvaccinated player.Rodgers now claims the issue extended beyond his own situation.“A lot of people had probably FAKE vax cards back in the day too," Rodgers said. “I remember seeing some of the vax cards. It was like written in CRAYON."The remark immediately raises questions about how widely fraudulent vaccination documentation may have been used inside professional sports.However, Rodgers did not provide a verified number of players who allegedly used fake cards.A former NFL scout using the name “AngryScoutVet” on X subsequently claimed that he had firsthand knowledge of players who obtained fake vaccination records.“I know this for a fact to be true," he wrote on X. "I know some players really well who told me they got fake vax cards. I have no clue the overall numbers but had a player tell me he thought 50% or more of those who supposedly got the vax actually got a fake card. I wondered if that % was close."The figure mentioned by the scout remains an unverified estimate. There is no evidence in the supplied reporting establishing that half of NFL players used fake vaccination cards.Rodgers' comments carry extra weight because his own vaccination status became one of the NFL's biggest off-field stories during the 2021 season.After testing positive, Rodgers explained that he had pursued alternative treatment rather than receiving a COVID-19 vaccine approved for use in the United States. The NFL and NFL Players Association did not accept that treatment as equivalent to vaccination, and Rodgers was subject to the protocols applied to unvaccinated players.The controversy became even more intense after his use of the word “immunized” was scrutinized. Rodgers later acknowledged that he had misled some people about his vaccination status while maintaining that he had been truthful about his broader position.That history explains why his latest comments have attracted attention years later.Rodgers is now preparing for another NFL season with the Steelers, but his opinions away from football continue to generate headlines. His recent remarks about Dr. Anthony Fauci and the pandemic have already sparked reactions, while Pittsburgh has emphasized that players are entitled to their personal views.The latest fake-vaccine-card allegations add another layer to a controversy that has never completely disappeared from Rodgers' public image. For now, however, the claims about other NFL players remain allegations rather than independently verified facts.
Article Summary: Aaron Rodgers claims some NFL players may have relied on fake vaccine cards in 2020. Former NFL scout backs Rodgers' claim, saying he personally knew players who told him they had obtained fraudulent documentation. Rodgers made the comments while discussing the COVID-19 era during an appearance on The Pat McAfee Show.

Article Title: Who was Chandler David Hendry? Mormon YouTuber dies at 27 in tragic Utah car crash as his final afterlife video leaves followers mourning
Article Text:
Chandler David Hendry built a growing audience through faith-based content

Chandler David Hendry’s final Instagram video focused on the afterlife

Chandler David Hendry’s sudden death has left followers of his religious content mourning a young creator whose online career had only begun to take off. The 27-year-old Mormon influencer and podcaster was killed in a three-vehicle crash in Lehi, Utah, on August 7. His death came just hours after he shared a video reflecting on the afterlife and eternal family connections.Hendry became known online through his Restored Truth podcast and social media accounts, where he discussed Christianity, scripture, church history and questions surrounding the faith. Although he only began posting content in 2025, he quickly developed a following across several platforms.His audience included nearly 13,000 YouTube subscribers, more than 48,000 Instagram followers and around 15,000 TikTok followers, according to reports.The Utah crash happened at around 8:25 a.m. on August 7 at the intersection of Timpanogos Highway and Morning Vista Road in Lehi. Police said witnesses reported that Hendry ran a red light before his vehicle struck two other cars. The occupants of those vehicles were not injured, while Hendry was taken to a hospital and later pronounced dead. Police also said he was not wearing a seat belt.The circumstances have added a painful dimension to the loss for people who followed Hendry's work.He had become a recognizable voice in a growing online community focused on religious discussion and Mormon faith.Perhaps the most striking detail surrounding Hendry's death is the subject of his final Instagram post. Shortly before the crash, he shared a video discussing a presentation by Anthony Sweat at the FAIR conference.Hendry focused on an illustration connected to Latter-day Saint teachings about sealings, family relationships and the afterlife. His discussion centered on the idea that family connections could continue into eternity.“So, last night at FAIR, Anthony Sweat presented this picture of the first rendition of the afterlife in Latter-day Saint Thought in regard to sealings. And this is the first ever picture of the plan of salvation and how it works within sealings of families. And basically identifying a link of lineages all the way back to Adam. That is what the eternities will look like. A link of the family is unit of God, which I find super interesting. Because this posits the idea in Doctrine and Covenants 132 when it says prosperity, it's associated with the prosperity of all of the ages of your lineage. Not future creations that you're going to have. Kinda interesting. I don't know. Let me know your thoughts.”The timing of the post has resonated deeply with his followers, although there is no indication that Hendry knew what would happen later that morning.Tributes have since appeared across social media and within his religious community. A candlelight vigil was also held in his memory on August 10.For many who discovered Hendry through his videos, his legacy will be tied not only to his growing platform but also to the faith and family themes that shaped much of his short career.
Article Summary: Chandler David Hendry, 27, was killed in a three-vehicle crash in Lehi, Utah, on August 7. His death came just hours after he shared a video reflecting on the afterlife and eternal family connections. Hendry became known online through his Restored Truth podcast and social media accounts, where he discussed Christianity, scripture and church history.

Article Title: Kim Kardashian and Lewis Hamilton’s 2014 photo resurfaces as fans call it ‘proof’ of invisible string theory
Article Text:
Kim Kardashian and Lewis Hamilton (Getty Images)

Why Kim Kardashian and Lewis Hamilton’s old photo is going viral

What is the invisible string theory behind Kim Kardashian and Lewis Hamilton?

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

A decade-old celebrity photo has suddenly become one of the internet’s favorite pieces of relationship evidence. A 2014 image showing Kim Kardashian and Lewis Hamilton at the same event has resurfaced after the pair’s romance became public, sending fans back to a time when neither appeared likely to become the other’s partner. Now, social media users are calling the coincidence a perfect example of the viral “invisible string theory.”The photograph was taken at the 2014 GQ Men of the Year Awards in London. At the time, Hamilton was dating Nicole Scherzinger, while Kardashian was with Ye, formerly known as Kanye West.More than a decade later, the image looks very different.One Reddit post shared the photograph with the caption, “This 2014 picture really hits different in 2026.” Another commenter simply asked, “What do they call it? The invisible string theory?”The idea has also been picked up by entertainment media, with Page Six describing Kardashian and Hamilton as possible “proof” that the theory “really does exist.”The fascination is not difficult to understand. Kardashian and Hamilton had already been part of the same celebrity circle for years before romance rumors emerged. Their paths crossed at major fashion, entertainment and sporting events, long before they publicly acknowledged their relationship.Their romance began attracting serious attention in 2026 after reports linked them to a private getaway. The relationship later became increasingly visible, including their appearance together around the Super Bowl and Kardashian’s support for Hamilton at the Monaco Grand Prix.Hamilton also publicly acknowledged Kardashian’s support after his second-place finish in Monaco, saying, “It's amazing to have her come this weekend and have the support ... It's amazing to have good people around you and good people supporting you and she does that for me every day.”By June, Kardashian had made the relationship more public through social media, confirming what had previously been the subject of intense speculation.The “invisible string theory” is not a scientific theory. It is a romantic idea based on the belief that certain people are connected by an unseen force and may eventually find their way to each other.Its roots stretch back centuries. Chinese folklore, for example, includes the idea of a red thread connecting people who are destined to meet. The modern version became especially popular online after Taylor Swift referenced an invisible connection in her song “Invisible String.”Social media has since turned the concept into a way for people to explain strange coincidences in relationships. Old photographs, childhood encounters and unexpected meetings are often revisited after two people eventually become romantically involved.That is exactly what has happened with Kardashian and Hamilton.The theory can be comforting, particularly for people recovering from heartbreak or searching for a meaningful relationship. But relationship experts also warn against taking the idea too literally. Believing someone is “meant” for you can sometimes encourage people to overlook incompatibility or tolerate unhealthy behavior.For Kardashian and Hamilton, the 2014 photograph cannot prove that fate connected them. It does, however, offer a striking snapshot of two people whose lives were already overlapping long before romance entered the picture.And that may be why the old image feels so different in 2026.
Article Summary: A decade-old celebrity photo has suddenly become one of the internet’s favorite pieces of relationship evidence. A 2014 image showing Kim Kardashian and Lewis Hamilton at the same event has resurfaced. Social media users are calling the coincidence a perfect example of the viral “invisible string theory.”

Article Title: Inside Erling Haaland’s unlikely friendship with billionaire founder: Luxury trips, WAGs and a ‘bromance’ beyond football

Inside Erling Haaland’s unlikely friendship with billionaire founder: Luxury trips, WAGs and a ‘bromance’ beyond football

How Erling Haaland and Umar Kamani have stayed close

Erling Haaland’s friendship with PrettyLittleThing founder Umar Kamani is not the usual football friendship. The Manchester City striker and the billionaire fashion businessman have been close since they met in 2022, with their bond taking them from Manchester to Dubai, Monaco and the French Riviera. Their partners and friends have also joined them on some of these trips. This summer, after Norway’s World Cup campaign, Haaland and Kamani were seen holidaying together in the south of France. The friendship has also opened doors into each other’s worlds, including a reported link-up between Haaland and basketball legend Michael Jordan.The Daily Mail reported that Haaland first started visiting the PrettyLittleThing offices in Manchester after he joined Manchester City in 2022. Kamani, a Manchester City supporter, already knew several players, and they helped introduce him to Haaland.The two quickly became friends. Football was an obvious connection, but they also share an interest in luxury watches, travel and trying different experiences. Haaland’s relaxed personality appears to have helped the relationship grow naturally. As the report put it, his attitude was simply: “why not?”Their friendship soon moved beyond Manchester. During the 2022 World Cup in Qatar, which Norway did not qualify for, Haaland took a break and visited Kamani in Dubai.By the following summer, Haaland and his father Alf-Inge Haaland were spending time with Kamani on a yacht. Fashion designer Tommy Hilfiger was also part of that trip, and the group later met Prince Albert II of Monaco for lunch. The 2023 gathering was also reported by Goal.Haaland and Kamani continued to spend time together in Dubai. The footballer attended a New Year party hosted by Kamani and also visited the businessman’s private gym, The Kamani Club. They were photographed together in ice baths after training.Their social circles have overlapped too. Kamani’s wife Nada and Haaland’s partner Isabel Haugseng Johansen have been part of their wider holiday group. The friendship has also connected Haaland to people outside football, with the Daily Mail reporting that one of Kamani’s close friends helped arrange Haaland’s recent meeting with Michael Jordan.There is also a personal side to the friendship. Haaland is known for the amount of work he puts into his fitness and recovery, while Kamani built his career around the fashion business. Both have demanding professional lives, but they appear to have found time to spend away from work.That became particularly clear after Haaland’s exhausting 2025-26 season. The Manchester City striker played 67 games for club and country and later said on Snapchat that his brain was “fried”. His summer was even busier because Norway made a historic run at the 2026 World Cup.Haaland scored twice as Norway beat Brazil 2-1 in the last 16, sending the country into the World Cup quarter-finals for the first time. He finished the tournament with seven goals after Norway lost 2-1 to England after extra time.Kamani has also built a major name for himself through PrettyLittleThing. He co-founded the fashion company with his brother Adam in 2012 after growing up in Manchester and coming from a family involved in fashion. Speaking to Drapers, he once explained his connection to the industry: “It’s impossible for me not to be working in fashion. I was born into fashion. That’s like saying if you couldn’t breathe what would you do?”His business career has not been without controversy. Boohoo, the parent company linked to the Kamani family, faced major criticism over working conditions in Leicester in 2020. The company later faced further legal claims from investors. In response to those claims, Boohoo said: “The company strongly contests the allegations and will vigorously defend any claim.”For Haaland and Kamani, however, the friendship has continued through football seasons, business demands and trips abroad. Their connection is unusual mainly because it brings together two very different worlds, one built around elite football and the other around fashion and business, while their shared interests have kept the friendship going since 2022.

The Manchester City striker and the billionaire fashion businessman have been on trips to Dubai, Monaco and the French Riviera. The friendship has also opened doors into each other’s worlds, including a reported link-up between Haal and basketball legend Michael Jordan. Their connection is unusual because it brings two very different worlds together.

Article Title: “Don’t focus on the past; focus on what’s going on now”: How Rashee Rice survived 30 days in a Texas jail and came out saying it changed his entire mindset
Article Text:
Rashee Rice breaks silence on jail time (Getty Images)

What did Rashee Rice say about his 30 days in jail?

How has Rashee Rice's off-field record affected his NFL career so far?

Is Rashee Rice ready to play for the Chiefs in 2026?

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Rashee Rice stepped back in front of cameras at Chiefs training camp on Tuesday with a lot to answer for. The 26-year-old wide receiver had spent the better part of his offseason behind bars in Dallas County Jail, the direct result of a THC-positive drug test that triggered his pre-existing 30-day sentence from a 2024 highway racing case. He missed organized team activities, mandatory minicamp, and weeks of knee rehabilitation following surgery -- all while teammates and coaches waited. On Tuesday, he finally spoke. And what he said was less a rehearsed apology than something more raw.Rashee Rice did not dress it up. "A learning experience. A reality check," he said, when asked to reflect on the summer. "Don't focus on the past; focus on what's going on now."He was booked into Dallas County Jail on May 19 after testing positive for a cannabis substance, which violated the terms of a plea agreement he had signed in July 2025. That agreement gave him five years of deferred probation and a 30-day jail term stemming from a March 2024 crash on a Dallas highway -- one where he and an acquaintance were driving at speeds up to 120 mph in a Lamborghini Urus before losing control and triggering a four-car chain reaction.He was released on June 16.The timing hurt on multiple levels. Rice had undergone a clean-up procedure on his right knee in May, and instead of rehabbing at the team's facility in Kansas City, he was managing recovery inside a jail cell. He said the mental strain was harder than the physical."It was tough. Mentally tough," Rice said. "They gave me ways to communicate with my teammates still, as well as my athletic trainer. Besides the hard times in there, I kept my mind right watching shows and as much Kevin Hart as I can to laugh. Then without that, just communicating with everybody on the outside."There is something almost absurd about that image -- one of the NFL 's most naturally gifted receivers, watching stand-up comedy clips in a Texas jail to get through the day. But that is the reality Rice has been navigating, and he is not shying away from it.The question hanging over Rashee Rice is not whether he is talented -- it is whether he can be trusted. The record is difficult to ignore. The 2024 Dallas crash cost him a six-game suspension at the start of the 2025 season, plus more than $115,000 in restitution paid to victims. Then this past February, the mother of his children named him in a civil assault lawsuit in Dallas County. Rice was not criminally charged, and the NFL declined to act, citing insufficient evidence. But for a player already living under a cloud, it added another headline he did not need.When available, he has been outstanding. He caught 156 passes for 1,797 yards and 14 touchdowns across his first three seasons, and he was part of the Chiefs' Super Bowl run after 2023. But he has played just 28 games in those three years. Injuries, suspensions, and now jail time have repeatedly interrupted what should have been a straightforward ascent.Now he is in the final year of his rookie contract. Whatever happens this season -- on the field and off it -- determines what comes next. Another team may look at his history and pass. The Chiefs may look at it and do the same. Or Rice plays a clean, dominant 2026 season and rewrites the story entirely.Early in training camp, Rashee Rice was visibly cautious on his right knee -- hesitant to fully open up, not quite trusting his body after surgery. But over the past week, that hesitation has faded. He has moved back into full team drills, and Patrick Mahomes has been finding him regularly. Rice spent part of his offseason rehabbing alongside Mahomes, who was himself recovering from knee ligament surgery, at the team's Kansas City facility once released from jail.Among his teammates, Rice appears to have retained genuine standing. Some Chiefs players wore "Free 4" shirts before his return from suspension last season. That kind of loyalty is not performative -- it reflects something real about how he is perceived in that locker room."I'm 100 percent locked in on what's going on now with the team," Rice said. "Ready to go out there and dominate, and I've got a good group of brotherhood behind me."He acknowledged the contract situation is on his mind, but framed it in a way that felt deliberate rather than deflective. "It's motivating," Rice said. "Honestly, just being able to be back on the field with my brothers right now is motivating. That's in the future. I'm just focused on what's going on right now, and that's getting better for the team."When asked what he wanted people to know about him beyond the headlines, Rice said: "I'm a positive guy. I'm a great person to feed off as far as energy, a smiling guy mostly at all times. And I'm a father, so I take the most responsibility in being a good father to my boys."That last part landed differently from everything else. The bravado of a contract-year receiver, the polished camp-speak -- it all gave way to something more grounded. Rice has made costly mistakes. He knows it. What the 2026 season decides is whether he has actually learned from them.
Article Summary: Rashee Rice spent the better part of his offseason behind bars in Dallas County Jail. He missed organized team activities, mandatory minicamp, and weeks of knee rehabilitation. Rice: "A learning experience. A reality check" The question hanging over Rice is whether he can be trusted.
